environment: Local Chromium, synthetic auth/WebRTC/model transports; actual app, PGlite SQL/RLS/RPC and IndexedDB. No live accounts or conversations.

tests.name: call-transition
stdout: PASS: real pending connection cues, two-part readiness, no artificial connect delay, and one greeting.
PASS: immediate microphone/audio/control/avatar stop, a short ended frame, and parallel late-transcript preservation.
PASS: failed connection cleanup/retry, silent AudioContext fallback, and idempotent data-channel closure.

tests.name: end-transcript
stdout: PASS: received and late-final speech is readable immediately during held append/finish; failed feedback keeps the full transcript.
PASS: reload restores exact server transcript rows and the generated/heard warning before optional time metadata; ended-call history opens its actual transcript directly.
PASS: zero-turn transcript states that no speech is available and never invents a successful review.
PASS: transcription failure preserves received speech and visible partial/save recovery without claiming completion.
PASS: explicit received-only recovery updates partial status while preserving the missing-audio limitation.
PASS: device-save failure still exposes received text with explicit unconfirmed storage and no false completed call.

tests.name: post-call-experience
stdout: PASS: mobile first action, collapsed transcript, current-call scope, direct recall, honest durable save and clean completion, restored hub, background completion, empty speech and analysis recovery.
